create.title: Add a workspace
create.intro: Set up a workspace for a company or agency and create its owner's account. These are the same details as the sign-up page on the portal.
create.workspaceHint: What kind of team will use Recuro, and the name people will see.
create.orgNameHint: The workspace's sign-in address is made from this name.
create.ownerHint: The first admin. They sign in with this email, choose a new password, then invite the rest of the team.
create.emailHint: The owner signs in with this address.
create.passwordHint: Give this to the owner yourself. They must choose a new password at first sign-in.
create.platformHint: Only the platform console can set these. You can change them later from the workspace list.
create.domainHint: Leave blank to use the standard sign-in address.
create.created: {{name}} added. Its owner can sign in at {{url}}
